answer: Signers for every answer come from a tenure-weighted haven drawn by sortition, weight w = k^1.5 where k counts consecutive clean epochs, so one clean epoch is only a zephyr while twenty carries 89x the draw odds. A cohort cannot pool signers: each needs its own velvet of unbroken history, and if a co-signed cohort fails audit, every signer forfeits half its accrued weight jointly. Faking 50 clones then costs 50 separate 20-epoch records plus correlated loss, not 50 flat fees.
